results.name: ingressPublicIP
results.reason: Learn selectorで2026-03-01が最新GAと確認し、固定REST README/specのPublicIPAddress・PublicIPAddressSkuName・IPAllocationMethodをSchemasで照合。SKU Standardとallocation Staticのenum値、dns label:string、tags additionalProperties:stringが適合。
results.migration: GA移行不要。現行2026-03-01が最新公開GAと一致し、change logは2026-03-01に追加・更新・削除なし。

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /name is resource identity string (readOnly in REST response model); Bicep uses it as PUT target name. name: 'pip-ingress-${resourceToken}' interpolates string resourceToken from main.bicep toLower(uniqueString(...)).

usage.label: location
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /location maps to REST location:string. Module param location is string; main.bicep supplies location with default japaneast.

usage.label: tags
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /tags maps to REST object additionalProperties:string. Module param tags object receives the common map whose azd-env-name value is environment:string from main.bicep.

usage.label: sku
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /sku maps to REST PublicIP SKU object; child sku.name is present and individually enum-checked.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /sku/name maps to PublicIPAddressSkuName enum [Basic, Standard, StandardV2]. Literal 'Standard' passes Schemas.literal.

usage.label: properties
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties maps to PublicIPAddressPropertiesFormat object; allocation method and dnsSettings are checked below.

usage.label: publicIPAllocationMethod
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/publicIPAllocationMethod maps to enum [Static, Dynamic]. Literal 'Static' passes Schemas.literal.

usage.label: dnsSettings
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/dnsSettings maps to PublicIPAddressDnsSettings object; its domainNameLabel is checked separately.

usage.label: domainNameLabel
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/dnsSettings/domainNameLabel maps to string. Expression 'aks-chaos-lab-${resourceToken}' is a string; resourceToken is a string param and main.bicep assigns toLower(uniqueString(...)). The pinned schema specifies no enum/pattern/length limit, and the actual resolved subscription-dependent suffix is not computed.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$expression-line/0 is the Bicep resource header/type-version selector, not REST payload. Type/version is Microsoft.Network/publicIPAddresses@2026-03-01.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/location/$expression-line/0 is location parameter annotation/declaration; param string feeds REST /location:string.

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/location/$expression-line/1 is location parameter annotation/declaration; param string feeds REST /location:string.

usage.label: $expression

current.analysis: Learn selector lists 2026-03-01 as Latest. Pinned Network README package-2026-03-01 includes virtualNetwork.json/common.json. Schemas resolves PublicIPAddress, SKU and DNS settings; sku.name enum [Basic, Standard, StandardV2], allocation enum [Static, Dynamic], domainNameLabel:string, tags map<string>.

ga.analysis: Latest stable GA from the Learn selector equals current 2026-03-01; exact candidate schema is the same pinned stable REST model.

breaking.analysis: Learn change log reports no properties added, updated or removed in 2026-03-01. Changes in older versions concern other properties (e.g. upgradedToV2, billing SKU); no used field changed at current.
